from primitive_api import (
    check_success,
    list_accessible_objects,
    list_inventory,
    list_nearby_objects,
    move_direction,
    observe_world,
    pickup_object,
    put_object,
    rotate_direction,
    teleport_to_location,
    validate_action_call,
)

# Move east 1 step and north 1 step, then check where spectrometer is
r1 = move_direction("east")
r2 = move_direction("north")
obs = observe_world()
spec = list_nearby_objects(query="spectrometer")
print("Agent loc:", obs["agentLocation"])
print("Spec nearby:", spec)
print("Accessible:", list_accessible_objects())

# Move east to (19, 11), rotate north, pick up spectrometer (uuid 11878),
# then move back to (17, 12), face south (where Yugo uuid 43006 is), and give spectrometer to Yugo.

move_direction("east")
rotate_direction("north")
acc = list_accessible_objects()
print("Accessible at (19,11) facing north:", acc)

val_pick = validate_action_call("pickup_object", obj=11878)
print("Validate pickup:", val_pick)
if val_pick.get("ok"):
    res_pick = pickup_object(11878)
    print("Pickup result:", res_pick)

inv = list_inventory()
print("Inventory after pickup:", inv)

# Navigate back to (17, 12): from (19, 11) move south to (19, 12) or west twice then south
move_direction("west")
move_direction("south")
move_direction("west")
rotate_direction("south")

obs2 = observe_world()
acc2 = list_accessible_objects()
print("Agent loc back:", obs2["agentLocation"])
print("Accessible facing south:", acc2)

val_put = validate_action_call("put_object", obj=11878, target=43006)
print("Validate put:", val_put)
if val_put.get("ok"):
    res_put = put_object(11878, 43006)
    print("Put result:", res_put)

print("Check success:", check_success())
